name: Close-Grip Push-Up
steps: Set up in a high plank with hands placed just inside shoulder width and body straight.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes to hold a straight line from head to heels.
Bend your elbows close to your ribs to lower your chest between your hands.
Press firmly through both palms until your arms straighten back to the plank.
tips: Keep your hips in line with your shoulders and ankles without sagging.
Tuck your elbows near your sides rather than letting them flare out wide.
